Location:	Airport West, VIC, 3042
Full-Time:	Immediate start
Job Title:	Panel Beater
Salary Range;	$79,500 - $87,000 | depending on skills level and work experience + superannuation.
Job Closes Date;	30 Days  

About the Client
We are recruiting on behalf of a premium Collision Repair Centre that specializes in high-quality vehicle restoration. They use advanced measuring systems and modern spray booths, and pride themselves on precision work for all makes and models. Their team is committed to returning each vehicle to factory standards.

Key Duties and Responsibilities

Body & Panel Replacement
• Remove damaged panels, upholstery, and accessories to access structural areas; then replace severely damaged sections with OEM or quality secondhand panels.
• Fit repaired or replacement panels, realign gaps, and reinstall body hardware such as door locks, trims, and weather seals.

Dent Removal & Surface Finishing
• Hammer out dents carefully to restore original contours, then fill depressions with plastic filler and file, grind, and sand surfaces to a smooth finish.
• Final check panel alignment and ensure surfaces are ready for painting (spray painting may also be required).

Straightening & Welding
• Use mechanical and hydraulic equipment to straighten damaged vehicles and components.
• Cut and join replacement sections using MIG/TIG welding, ensuring structural integrity.

Additional Duties
• Assist in constructing or restoring custom designed, vintage, or specialty vehicles as needed.
• Maintain a clean, safe workspace and comply with all workplace health and safety standards.

Requirements
• A formal trade qualification as a Panel Beater or equivalent. 
• A minimum of 2 years of post-apprenticeship experience in a professional panel beating role within the automotive repair industry. 
• Proven, hands-on expertise in vehicle structural repair, including the use of frame straightening jigs and measuring systems. 
• High proficiency in MIG/MAG welding and a strong understanding of metal finishing techniques. 
• A meticulous eye for detail and a unwavering commitment to restoring vehicles to manufacturer specifications. 
• The ability to work effectively both autonomously and as a collaborative member of a dedicated team. 
• A strong understanding and a proven commitment to adhering to all Workplace Health & Safety (WHS) and environmental guidelines. 
• A current driver's license.

Apply now to join a respected team with modern facilities and ongoing work.
Please submit your resume and a brief cover letter detailing your relevant experience. Applications will be reviewed as received, therefore, please apply as soon as possible before the closing date.

Please note: We are acting as recruitment agents on behalf of our client. Employer details will be provided to shortlisted candidates.
result.title: Panel Beater

result.description:
This role is responsible for leading all construction activities by ensuring the Project Teams are delivering projects to the highest standard and optimising resources while delivering projects on time and on budget without compromising quality or safety.

Your role will interact with and be supporting other key employees in continually developing, improving and monitoring project delivery systems, procedures and compliance protocols. With experience of effective project delivery, the Project Manager will always be a supporting and inspiring leader of best practice and professionalism for the wider project team.

This position offers the chance to be part of a friendly, supportive, tight-knit team. Your strong organisational and leadership skills, along with your ability to work autonomously will stand you in good stead. Experience and a track record of delivering projects is essential. You must have the right to live and work in Australia to be considered for this position.

KEY TASKS:

Liaising with clients to identify and define requirements, scope, and objectives

Ensuring that clients’ needs are met as projects evolve.

Ensuring project management activities, resources, equipment, and information are coordinated

Ensuring project financials are completed on time and progress claims are submitted in a timely manner

Analysing risks and opportunities

Overseeing project procurement management

Monitoring project progress and handle any issues that arise

Acting as the point of contact and communicate project status to all participants

Using tools to monitor working hours, plans and expenditures

Ensuring all appropriate legal paperwork is issued (e.p. contracts and terms of agreement)

Ensuring comprehensive project documentation, plans and reports are created and maintained

Ensuring standards and requirements are met through conducting quality assurance tests

Accurately utilising company project and financial management systems

Conducting contract reviews and train other team members where required to develop skills in this area

Acting as an advisor of Site Management processes & procedures to support the project construction

Operating as the Site Manager where required to ensure assigned projects continue according to schedule

Conducting regular applicable meetings (e.g. Project Control Group (PCG)) and ensure these are documented

Conducting and ensure a smooth handover of each project to clients

About the Role:
This role is central to the final and most visible stage of the restoration process. As a Vehicle Painter, you will be entrusted with transforming prepared vehicle bodies with a flawless, factory-quality finish. You will be responsible for colour matching, application, and finishing, ensuring the final product not only meets but exceeds customer expectations. This position requires an artist's eye for detail and a technician's understanding of modern refinishing systems.

Key Duties & Responsibilities:

Surface Preparation & Masking
• Identify and remove rough spots, imperfections, and old paint from vehicle panels using hand tools and power sanders.
• Mask off areas not requiring paint with precision tape and paper to ensure clean, sharp lines and protect surrounding components.

Paint Matching & Mixing
• Colour match and blend paints to achieve exact shade matches, including metallic and pearl finishes, and select pre-mixed paints as required.
• Adjust tint formulas and test spray-outs to guarantee seamless integration with existing vehicle paintwork.

Application & Finishing
• Apply primer, basecoat, and clearcoat using spray-guns, carefully sanding between coats for a smooth, defect-free surface.
• Perform touch-up repairs, then polish and wax completed paintwork to restore gloss and depth.

Final Detailing & Protection
• Remove masking materials, then wax and polish finished panels to a high lustre.
• Treat vehicles with rust-proofing chemicals and apply protective coatings as needed.

Specialist Work
• Paint custom signs, graphics, and artwork directly onto vehicles when required.

• A formal trade qualification in Vehicle Painting / Spray Painting or equivalent demonstrated experience or relevant qualification.
• A minimum of 1 year of proven experience as a Vehicle Painter within a professional automotive refinishing environment or similar.

POSITION

Full-time position for a Pressure Welder is available in Pinkenba, QLD, 4008.

SKILLS

At least an AQF Certificate III, including at least two years of on-the-job training or a Certificate Ivin a relevant field. At least three years of relevant experience may substitute for the formal qualification. In addition to the qualification at least one year of relevant work experience is required.

RESPONSIBILITIES

The Pressure Welder is responsible for assembling, welding, inspecting, testing and repairing pressure vessels, pipes, pipelines, boilers, tanks and associated pressure-containing components in accordance with engineering drawings, approved welding procedures, relevant Australian Standards and industry specifications.
The role requires precision welding using MMAW, GTAW (TIG), GMAW (MIG) and FCAW processes on carbon steel, stainless steel and alloy materials in workshop and site environments.

POSITION DUTIES

•	Read and interpret engineering drawings, blueprints, welding procedure specifications and technical specifications to determine job requirements and appropriate welding techniques for pressure systems.
•	Select, measure, cut, shape, bend, bevel, clean and prepare metal sections and pipes using hand tools, heating equipment and metalworking machinery.
•	Align, fit and secure pipes, vessel components and other pressure-containing components before welding.
•	Assemble, weld and repair pressure vessels, pipes, pipelines, boilers and tanks to relevant standards and approved welding procedures.
•	Operate welding equipment using MMAW, GTAW (TIG), GMAW (MIG) and FCAW
processes.
•	Weld in various positions, including vertical and overhead positions, and in confined spaces where required.
•	Conduct pre-heating, post-weld heat treatment, stress-relief and finishing processes as specified.
•	Examine welds for bead width, penetration, precision, defects and compliance with applicable standards and specifications.
•	Conduct or assist with pressure, leak and other weld-integrity testing to confirm that pressure-containing systems meet required standards.
•	Repair defective welds and complete rework in accordance with approved procedures.
•	Clean and smooth welds by grinding, filing, chiselling and polishing as required.
•	Perform routine inspection and maintenance of welding equipment and report equipment defects. 
•	Comply with workplace health and safety requirements, permit systems and safe work procedures.
•	Work collaboratively with fabricators, boilermakers, inspectors and engineers to complete work to specification.
